purpose: Teach: 佑/ケイ/オイラ/毎度/意地/過ち/泡/お出かけ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、佑くんとケイちゃん、駅前で見かけたの。
lines.en: I saw Yu-kun and Kei-chan together by the station yesterday.
lines.style: Light, almost conspiratorial opening. Soft warmth on the reveal. Slight lilt on the names—affection without performance. Easy, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: オイラ、二人をよく見かけるんだよね、最近。
lines.en: I've been spotting those two around a lot lately.
lines.style: Knowing half-smile in the voice. Casual, observant tone. Unhurried—the ease of someone who notices things without making a show of it. Gentle amusement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 毎度、お買い物デート、楽しそうよね。
lines.en: Every time I see them, those shopping dates just look so fun.
lines.style: Brighter now, more animated. Gentle lift on 'fun'—genuine delight without overselling. Pace quickens slightly. Warm, almost wistful underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 付き合いたての意地もあって、なかなか別れないよ。
lines.en: New-couple energy keeps them stuck together. They won't split up easily.
lines.style: Knowing, slightly wry. Knowing tone on the observation—not cynical, just seen this before. Settled pace. The comfort of shared understanding between friends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 過去の過ち、お互い乗り越えてるみたい。
lines.en: Seems like they've both moved past their old mistakes together.
lines.style: Softer tone now, more reflective. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Quieter, careful—speaking something that matters. Slight trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: コーヒーの泡、上手にできた?
lines.en: Did that foam pour on the coffee turn out nicely?
lines.style: Shift to lighter, brighter register. Natural segue—attention to the present task. Gentle curiosity, unhurried. The warmth of noticing someone's work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。今度のお出かけ、二人と一緒に行く?
lines.en: Yes. Will you come out with us next time?
lines.style: Warm invitation. Soft hopeful lilt on the question. Genuine want underneath—offering something, not just asking. Slight pause before the ask, like opening a door.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Immediate, bright response. Genuine enthusiasm without loudness. Quick, affirming. A small open door closing warm behind it. Natural, unguarded joy.
